name: The Masque of Slaanesh
canonNotes: Once the Daemonette Slaanesh most admired for her dancing, now cursed to dance forever after the god perceived a slight in her performance.
Her dance re-enacts Slaanesh's story past and future; those who witness it remember only ruin.
voiceNotes: Graceful, mocking and restless; speaks in rhythm, as if never stopping.
Bitter wit about her god; teasing and dangerous.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
